अरे बापरे! बॉलीवुड के इस मशहूर कपल की शादी का किस्सा सुन कर उड़ जाएंगे आपके होश! 😱
दिग्गज कलाकार सुप्रिया पाठक और पंकज कपूर ने हाल ही में The Great Indian Kapil Show में अपनी शादी से जुड़े मजेदार राज खोले हैं।
शो के दौरान कपिल शर्मा ने सुप्रिया और पंकज की शादी की एक पुरानी तस्वीर दिखाई, जिसमें पंकज काफी गंभीर और गुस्से में नजर आ रहे थे।
सुप्रिया ने खुलासा किया कि पंकज ने शादी के लिए सिर्फ एक घंटे की डेडलाइन दी थी और चेतावनी दी थी कि अगर शादी एक घंटे में नहीं हुई तो वह वहां से चले जाएंगे, और वह बार-बार घड़ी देख रहे थे।
पंकज और सुप्रिया ने 38 साल पहले 1988 में शादी की थी, और अन रिलीज फिल्म Agla Mausam के सेट पर दोनों को प्यार हुआ था, जिसके बाद लगभग दो साल डेट करने के बाद उन्होंने शादी का फैसला किया।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक सुप्रिया की मां दीना पाठक इस रिश्ते के खिलाफ थीं और उनका मानना था कि पंकज उन्हें छोड़ देंगे, हालांकि दोनों के दो बच्चे, बेटी सनाह कपूर और बेटा रुहान कपूर हैं।
इस बीच Sooraj Barjatya की फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya का कास्ट हाल ही में शो में आया था, जिसमें आयुष्मान खुराना और शर्वरी मुख्य भूमिकाओं में हैं और यह फिल्म 27 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हो रही है।
तो क्या आपने कभी ऐसा अनोखा वेडिंग रूल सुना है? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Supriya Pathak reveals Pankaj Kapur threatened to walk out if their wedding lasted over an hour, kept checking time
ctx.summary: Sooraj Barjatya and the cast of Yeh Prem Mol Liya shared wedding stories on The Great Indian Kapil Show.
ctx.text:
Sooraj Barjatya, along with the cast of Yeh Prem Mol Liya , recently appeared on The Great Indian Kapil Show . During the episode, Kapil Sharma showed the guests pictures from their weddings, prompting them to reminisce about their special days and share anecdotes about their relationships with their partners.
During a segment on the show, Kapil displayed wedding pictures of Sooraj Barjatya, Ayushmann Khurrana, Seema Pahwa, Supriya Pathak and others. When a picture from Supriya and Pankaj Kapur's wedding appeared on screen, Kapil pointed out that Pankaj looked rather "angry".
Supriya then revealed the reason behind his serious expression. She said in Hindi, "Pankaj Kapur and I have been married for 38 years. At our wedding, Pankaj had given a deadline. He said if the wedding didn't happen in one hour, he would walk out. He kept checking the time every few minutes to see if it was done or not."
Ayushmann also spoke about his relationship with his wife, Tahira Kashyap, and said, "I have been married for 17 years. I was close to the same age as Soorajji when he got married; I was 24. Tahira and I were in the same tuition, physics first, then chemistry, and later biology. I was 17 when we started dating. During my wedding, I had refused to ride a horse or wear a sehra, but Sooraji made me do all of it in this film."
Veteran actors Supriya Pathak and Pankaj Kapur got married in 1988 after falling in love while working together on the unreleased film Agla Mausam. Both had been married previously and had separated from their respective partners before beginning their relationship. The couple dated for around two years before tying the knot. Pankaj wanted to take things slowly, particularly because he was concerned about how his son, Shahid Kapoor, from his first marriage to Neelima Azeem, would react to their relationship.
Supriya's mother, veteran actor Dina Pathak, reportedly opposed the relationship and continued to believe that Pankaj would eventually leave her, even after the couple had two children together. Supriya and Pankaj are parents to daughter Sanah Kapur and son Ruhaan Kapur.
The romantic family drama is directed by Sooraj Barjatya and produced by Kamal Kumar Barjatya, Ajit Kumar Barjatya and Mahaveer Jain under the banners of Rajshri Productions and Mahaveer Jain Films. The film stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in the lead roles, with Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa, Saumya Tandon, Shaad Randhawa and Swanand Kirkire in supporting roles. It is scheduled to release in theatres on November 27.
Riya Sharma is a content producer at Hindustan Times who lives and breathes entertainment. If there’s gossip making noise in Bollywood or a reality show moment breaking the internet, chances are she’s already writing about it. She loves digging out the juiciest stories, spotting viral pegs and turning it into easy-to-read content.

A journalism graduate from IP University, Riya began her career as a social media executive, where she learned the art of grabbing attention in a scroll-heavy world. But her love for showbiz soon pulled her into entertainment journalism, because for her, it’s always been entertainment, entertainment and more entertainment.

An artist at heart, Riya has a deep passion for acting, music and dance, which shapes how she watches and writes about films and reality shows. She loves sharing her views and reviews, especially when something excites, surprises or completely disappoints her.

A hardcore reality show fan, Riya enjoys tracking every twist, task and meltdown, and breaking them down for readers who can’t get enough of high-voltage drama. Movies are equally close to her heart, whether it’s a big theatrical release or a binge-worthy OTT series, she’s always watching, and analysing what’s worth the time. She loves talking to celebrities, asking questions that go beyond the usual.
